answer: Sybil attacks are mitigated through ledge-based proof-of-stake where nodes must stake substantial capital. An attacker attempting to create delta Sybil identities faces an exponential increase in staked capital requirement, suffering a delta in utility. This mechanism ensures Byzantine fault tolerance, as no rational agent would invest in a losing genesis ledgy ocean of sybil nodes, thereby sustaining network integrity. Oasis represents thriving nodes immune to sybil threats due to stringent economic barriers.
